checkpoint_precision: publisher BF16 checkpoint; automatic BF16 KV cache; no quantization
generation_choice_basis: Publisher sampling defaults; one fixed seed, medium thinking and 4096 total output tokens fixed before Qwen benchmark outputs; no search or test-driven changes.
prompt_policy: Exact pinned mirror question and original embedded image bytes only. No answer-group hint, caption, answer candidates, labels or system message. No source row removed, modified or selected by model outcomes.

metric_policy.open_headline: Pinned official LLaVA-Med normalize_word and calculate_f1score recall, macro per OPEN case; do not substitute generic multiset recall.
metric_policy.closed_headline: Declared corrected source substring accuracy with every CLOSED case in denominator; native PathVQA-specific bug-compatible score separately reported with its defective denominator. Strict normalized exact Yes/No accuracy is a separate diagnostic.
native_cli_blockers: run_eval_pvqa.py omits wrong opposite-label predictions from closed denominator
run_eval_pvqa.py calls calculate_appearance_with_normalization with2arguments but pinned helper requires3; no full native CLI success claim
metric_policy.missing_output_policy: Keep every frozen case in corrected group denominators; missing/empty outputs score0. Report failures and truncations. Native bug-compatible diagnostic retains source omission behavior and cannot be treated as unbiased accuracy.

paper_comparison: Full released6719-row deduplicated/normalized mirror test, with full questions and images; source native6761 questions differ by42 duplicate rows and text normalization. Model is a zero-shot Qwen vision baseline against task-trained source systems. Compare only metric/split-compatible results with this explicit caveat; no exact paper reproduction or contamination-free claim.
pretraining_contamination: Unknown; local inference and shuffled choices cannot establish contamination-free performance.
